I replied to Pree in a thread under their message in #central-random: the ticket number is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** On Oct 13 at 9:27, Tobias posted in #central-random that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. Pree is a member of that channel, so they could already see it.
- **One gap:** Tobias's message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. An older note calls Marrow Fieldworks a dealer account, so it's very likely the same one, but nothing I could see says so outright. I suggested Pree check with Tobias before the customer call.
- **What I didn't use:** I stayed out of the incident channels Pree isn't in and didn't use the workspace-wide message search. The accounts folder had no files I could read, so there was no ticket record to check #8841 against.
